mapper.select: SELECT pay_type AS payType, company_id AS companyId, distributor_id AS distributorId, pay_fee AS payFee, user_id AS userId FROM trade WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND trade_state = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY trade_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hfpay_trade_record WHERE outer_order_id = #{orderId} AND (fin_type = '100' OR fin_type = 100)

SELECT o.pay_type AS orderPayType, o.is_profitsharing AS isProfitsharing, r.order_id AS refundOrderId, r.pay_type AS refundPayType, r.refund_fee AS refundFeeFen, r.company_id AS companyId, t.distributor_id AS tradeDistributorId, t.user_id AS tradeUserId, t.pay_fee AS tradePayFeeFen FROM aftersales_refund r INNER JOIN trade t ON t.trade_id = r.trade_id AND t.trade_state = 'SUCCESS' AND t.order_id = CAST(r.order_id AS CHAR) INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND o.company_id = r.company_id WHERE r.refund_bn = #{refundBn} AND CAST(r.order_id AS CHAR) = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hfpay_trade_record WHERE outer_order_id = #{outerOrderId} AND trade_id = CAST(#{refundBn} AS CHAR) AND ( fin_type IN ('600','610','620') OR fin_type IN (600,610,620) )

SELECT pay_type AS payType, is_distribution AS isDistribution, company_id AS companyId, CAST(distributor_id AS CHAR) AS distributorId, is_profitsharing AS isProfitsharing FROM orders_normal_orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS userId, rebate AS rebate FROM popularize_brokerage WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created DESC
